preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of colors is between 1 and the minimum of 40 or the total number of cells in the grid.
The number of missions is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The row indices for the starting and finishing cities are between 1 and n, inclusive.
The column indices for the starting and finishing cities are between 1 and m, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a_ij <= k for all i, j
preconditions.description: Each city is assigned a color between 1 and k, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output for each mission is the minimum possible time to travel from the start city to the finish city.
